rollback.rationale: R4: rollback for rung 2 is renaming the preserved legacy store back and reinstalling the previous version, rehearsed by TASK-653 on a captured copy; earlier rungs change no schema. Schema 14 to 15 rehearsed against baseline 97c3a7f15d98: the migration is interruptible at every exposed checkpoint and recovers, the baseline binary refuses the newer schema on a scratch copy rather than corrupting it, and a restored backup opens with the baseline again. Historical synthetic schema rollback scope is retained; this replan changes no product code or live store. TASK-616 and TASK-617 must document source-only rollback/stop behavior for their candidate changes; do not re-enable an unsafe runner as rollback. Captured-real-store and integrated-candidate rollback remain gate obligations.

monitoring.rationale: Still missing for this intent. R4 makes monitoring concrete: GATE-649 samples app CPU after the convergence stop, GATE-659 records a one-hour idle CPU trace and the capacity ring, and get_health (TASK-671) reports store caps and journal state. Historical monitoring evidence remains, but the orphaned test and frozen/ambiguous dashboard contradict an unconditional safety/visibility-ready claim. TASK-616 must establish external descendant-aware memory/time/output monitoring and confirmed cleanup; TASK-617 must establish coherent observation/freshness/alert visibility. GATE-619 and later gates require both findings resolved with current evidence. No such proof is claimed by this replan.
